Governance The Company’s Board of Directors oversees cybersecurity risks consistent with its general risk oversight responsibility.

The Audit Committee of the Board has specific responsibility for reviewing the status of the security of the Company’s electronic data processing information systems and the general security, including cybersecurity, of the Company’s people, assets and information systems.

In support of this general oversight, the full Board reviews, at least annually, the most significant enterprise risks facing the Company, including cybersecurity risks, as identified in the Company’s Enterprise Risk Management program.
This review, which includes key members of senior management, covers key risks from information security that have been identified and corresponding action plans.
